partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 2 marks (8x2 =16 marks)

partB.description: 2 questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 2 subdivisions. Each question carries 6 marks.  (4x6 = 24 marks)

courseOutcomes.description: Explain the architectural features and instructions of the ARM microcontrollers.
Develop applications involving interfacing of external devices and I/O with ARM microcontroller.
Use various communication protocols of interaction with peer devices and peripherals.
Demonstrate the use of a real time operating system in embedded system applications.
Apply hardware security features of ARM in real world applications.
